messages:
deploy-bot: Promotion attempt payments:v2.4.1 -> staging failed during post-upgrade hook. Error: hook job timed out and left resources locked in namespace payments-staging.
Maya R: ugh, saw this locally earlier today with the migration hook hanging.
Maya R: grabbing job logs now (`kubectl logs job/payments-migration-hook -n payments-staging`).
Colin H: what does the hook do? db migration, right? if it's idempotent we can force delete and retry.
Anita S: yes it runs schema migration + seed. It SHOULD be idempotent but there's a legacy lock file step that can hang if PV attach is slow.
Jamie L: can we avoid blocking the whole promotion? maybe pin backend chart and promote non-db parts?
Maya R: deploy-bot tried a rollback automatically but helm release stayed in FAILED because the hook job is still Present.
Maya R: log snippet: `Waiting for job payments-migration-hook to complete... deadline exceeded`
Colin H: quick manual fix: `kubectl delete job payments-migration-hook -n payments-staging --force --grace-period=0` then mark release as failed/rolled back. I'm inclined to do manual delete to clear lock.
Anita S: +1 but only if we know migration didn't partially apply creating inconsistent state. need audit.
Jamie L: ops, can you check PV attach events around 10:14Z? might explain hang.
ops-bot: PV attach for pvc payments-migrations-claim in payments-staging had repeated AttachVolume error 10:12Z-10:18Z, AWS volume was in attaching state >5m.
Maya R: so likely stuck waiting on PV attach. deleting the job is safe for rollback, migration just didn't complete. we'll schedule a dedicated retry in the change window.
Colin H: action items: 1) manual delete hook job to clear namespace lock, 2) mark this promotion as aborted and pin chart (v2.4.0) in the promote job so dependent charts don't get partial updates, 3) add note in release notes about migration retry plan.
Maya R: I'll run the deletion now and kick rollback.
Maya R: `kubectl delete job payments-migration-hook -n payments-staging --force --grace-period=0`
deploy-bot: Received manual intervention: job deleted by Maya R. Initiating rollback for payments:v2.4.1 -> staging.
deploy-bot: Rollback complete. Release payments now at v2.4.0 in staging.
Anita S: create follow-up ticket to make the migration hook idempotent and add a short preflight PV check. Tagging SRE.
Jamie L: also add a small guard in chart promotion pipeline: if a hook job exists >5m, auto-fence the release and notify oncall rather than leaving it pending.
Colin H: for immediate safety, I'll pin the promotion task to v2.4.0 and re-run the non-db charts after change window.
Maya R: adding a short blurb to release notes: "Staging promotion for payments v2.4.1 aborted due to migration hook PV attach failure; rollback to v2.4.0. Migration will be retried in next nightly window after PV stability checks."
Jamie L: sounds good. @deploy-bot can you attach the rollback artifact and label the thread for postmortem? :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Rollback artifact attached. Label: release:payments; incident-tag:migration-hook.
ops-bot: Confirmed PV attach stabilized at 10:45Z. Will run a one-off dry-run of hook in staging tomorrow 02:00Z during change window.
Maya R: thanks all — reopening follow-up ticket and will own the retry.
Colin H: o/
Anita S: thanks, closing out here.
